description: Returns the secure link to start an application on puntoseguro.com for one quote, identified by an insurer id from list_life_insurance_quotes, a coverage option, the date of birth and the coverage amount. The application, health questionnaire and signature are completed by the user on puntoseguro.com; this tool submits nothing and collects no personal data. The final premium is subject to the insurer's underwriting.

coverage_amount_eur.description: Requested life-insurance coverage amount in euros

coverage_variant.description: Coverage option the user chose; death if the user has not chosen another

insurer_id.description: Insurer id returned by list_life_insurance_quotes for the same date of birth and coverage amount

name: start_life_insurance_application

title: Start a life-insurance application
